title: Benefits of Using Perplexity AI to Search for Information on Complex Medical Issues
summary:
In today's world—and especially in the field of medicine—there is an enormous amount of information available. However, it is often difficult to find the right information quickly.
The aim of this study is to test the extent to which the use of “Perplexity,” an AI that can be directed in real time and provides source citations, makes it easier for us to find reliable information compared to conventional methods, specifically a Google search.
conditions: The subjects are medical students and healthcare professionals.

interventions.name:
Two groups will be randomly assigned to complete the online questionnaire via RedCap.
The questionnaire is divided into two parts.
Group 1 will first use Perplexity for the first part, followed by a simple Google search for the second part.
Group 2 will first use a simple Google search for the first part, followed by Perplexity for the second part.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Medical students who have reached the clinical semester or members of a medical profession (physicians, nurses, emergency medical technicians, medical technologists, etc.) with at least 3 years of professional training (primarily medical students and resident physicians)
Exclusion criteria:
Not a member of the medical profession or with less than 3 years of
professional training. Pre-clinical medical student.
